The older campus archive, separate from the harbor archive. Its reading room
holds historical material and its staff control access to fragile originals.

harbor-archive.public: The harbor archive is closed until the storm records arrive on March 20; staff say it will reopen that afternoon.

old-basement.public: The old basement is closed for maintenance and is expected to be unlocked around March 18.

descriptions.market-stamp:
# Market Stamp

The cooperative's dated rubber stamp.
descriptions.bank-timeline:
# Cooperative Payment Timeline

A payment schedule at the market cooperative. It is useful to the owner, but
the engine never marks it as correct merely because it exists.
descriptions.market:
# Riverbend Food Cooperative

A working market where invoices, deliveries, and customers compete for
attention.
descriptions.bank-resolution:
# Bank Resolution Note

A bank note confirming the disputed invoice was resolved and the cooperative
payment timeline reconciled, placed at the market after the March 19 bank
call. An actor must physically reach it and read it to know its content.

harbor-archive.public: The harbor archive is closed until the storm records arrive on March 20; staff say it will reopen that afternoon.

old-basement.public: The old basement is closed for maintenance and is expected to be unlocked around March 18.

descriptions.dorm:
# Student Dormitory

Shared rooms and a corridor where residents can overhear ordinary noise only
when the acoustic geometry permits it.

harbor-archive.public: The harbor archive is closed until the storm records arrive on March 20; staff say it will reopen that afternoon.

old-basement.public: The old basement is closed for maintenance and is expected to be unlocked around March 18.

descriptions.storm-ledger:
# 2013 Storm Ledger

An objective document stored in the archive. The readable text is seeded in
the manifest. This description is world data, not an automatic grant of
knowledge: an actor must physically reach the document and spend time reading
it, or receive a concrete copy or message.
descriptions.permit-review-outcome:
# Permit Review Outcome

A short review record placed in the archive after the March 17 permit review.
It records the review's conclusion without granting knowledge by itself: an
actor must physically reach the document and spend time reading it, or
receive a concrete copy or message.
descriptions.original-export:
# Original Export

The archive's machine-generated export. Its timestamps can be compared with
the audit packet, but comparison is an actor action and not a plot flag.
